details: KG-UV9GX+ on Windows (1.0.79, COM3) fails every read at identification. CHIRP kguv9dplus waits 250 ms total for the 75-byte ident tail; the radio delivered 26-27 bytes. OEM KG-UV9D(Plus) CPS allows ReadInterval 388 ms, 100 ms/byte + 1000 ms, and sleeps 150 ms after the request.
summary: Ident reply cut short: Wanted 75, got 27/26
